tier_reason: Independent third-party CI shootout (ahaoboy/js-engine-benchmark: V8 v7 suite code in v8-v7/ forked from mozilla/arewefastyet, driver scripts/update.ts, MuJS built by ahaoboy/mujs-build build.yml with the public Makefile's -O3) shows MuJS Score 435/522/339 vs goja 365/358/229 on ubuntu/macos-arm64/windows; not A because the runners' CPU models and compiler versions are not stated. Upgraded from C to B for consistency with the other entries tiered from this suite (ChakraCore, V8, njs, quanta, ant, lo, bare, ladybird, lumen, SpiderMonkey).

corrections.claimed_speedup: V8 v7 overall Score, README snapshot 10/11/2026 (higher is better; MuJS reported as version 1.3.8): ubuntu MuJS 435 vs goja 365, Boa 279, Jint 246 (1.19x, 1.56x, 1.77x, derived from page data); macos-arm64 MuJS 522 vs goja 358, Boa 302, Jint 239 (1.46x, 1.73x, 2.18x, derived from page data); windows MuJS 339 vs goja 229, Jint 159 (1.48x, 2.13x, derived from page data; Boa has no score there). The same tables put MuJS below the category incumbents Duktape (682 / 842 / 371) and QuickJS (1522 / 1672 / 1105).
corrections.compiler_and_flags: MuJS: ahaoboy/mujs-build .github/workflows/build.yml clones the Codeberg HEAD daily and runs 'make release HAVE_READLINE=no'; the Makefile (checked at GitHub mirror commit 05cd646; the Codeberg HEAD copy could not be opened) compiles the one.c amalgamation with '-std=c99 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -O3' using the runner's default cc (gcc on ubuntu-latest, Apple clang on macos-latest, MinGW-w64 gcc under MSYS2 on windows-latest; versions not stated). goja: ahaoboy/goja-build runs 'go build ./goja/main.go' on dop251/goja HEAD with default Go toolchain settings.
corrections.workload: V8 v7 benchmark suite (Richards, DeltaBlue, Crypto, RayTrace, EarleyBoyer, RegExp, Splay, NavierStokes) run once per engine per daily GitHub Actions job through each engine's CLI; base.js times every benchmark in-process (one warm-up Measure, then at least 1 s and 32 runs), and Score is the geometric mean of the per-benchmark scores, higher is better.
corrections.stars_or_usage: 858 stars and 103 forks on the GitHub mirror (canonical repo moved to Codeberg); packaged by Debian, Ubuntu and openSUSE (search snippets).
corrections.caveats: Nobody at the MuJS project claims this win; it is read off an automated third-party leaderboard (ahaoboy/js-engine-benchmark, 59 stars, regenerated daily, one run per engine per day on shared GitHub Actions runners whose CPU model is not stated). The only engines MuJS beats are interpreters written in other languages (goja in Go, Boa in Rust, Jint in .NET, plus es5, quickjs-oxide, xst and ringo); the category incumbents Duktape (about 1.57x, 1.61x and 1.09x faster on ubuntu, macos-arm64 and windows, derived from page data) and QuickJS (about 3.2-3.5x faster) beat it on every platform, so MuJS is not faster than the usual C embeddable JavaScript engines. Noise check: mujs-one, a c2rust translation of MuJS of unstated revision, scores 505 vs MuJS 435 on ubuntu, a gap close to the 1.19x ubuntu margin over goja; the macOS and Windows margins (1.46x, 1.48x) are larger and consistent. Score excludes process startup and CLI-wrapper overhead (base.js times in-process after a warm-up); only the Time(s) row includes it. The README rows align with the engine columns (MuJS's eight per-test values 310, 397, 241, 620, 534, 251, 818, 640 give the 435 Score as a geometric mean, derived from page data). The GitHub repo is a stub (README: 'This repository has migrated to https://codeberg.org/ccxvii/mujs'; last mirror commit 2385035 'Migrate to Codeberg.' on 2025-08-13, last mirror tag 1.3.7 on 2025-06-23); the Codeberg repo could not be opened here, but the benchmark's daily Codeberg build reports version 1.3.8 and Debian/Ubuntu ship a 1.3.8 tarball dated December 2025 (search snippet), so development continues there. notes: Numbers match the README snapshot exactly on all three platforms, and goja is a verified wave-12 entry, so the comparison stands; tier raised C to B to match every other entry tiered from this suite. Main shortcoming: MuJS only beats Go/Rust/.NET interpreters and is slower than Duktape and QuickJS on every platform. Consider a repo_url override to https://codeberg.org/ccxvii/mujs (GitHub is a migration stub; codeberg.org did not resolve from this container), and last_commit stays the mirror's 2025-08-13 because the Codeberg history could not be read.
